passage.label: O believed indeed among wives children enemies beware them; pardon overlook forgive indeed Allah Forgiving Merciful; wealth children trial Allah has great reward; fear Allah much able listen obey spend better selves whoever protected stinginess soul successful; loan Allah goodly loan multiply forgive Allah Most Appreciative Forbearing; Knower unseen witnessed Exalted Might Wise

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدِكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا لَّكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُمۡۚ وَإِن تَعۡفُواْ وَتَصۡفَحُواْ وَتَغۡفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
إِنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ
فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَٱسۡمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنفِقُواْ خَيۡرٗا لِّأَنفُسِكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
إِن تُقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعِفۡهُ لَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

mainSubject.label: Believers warned that some wives and children may be enemies requiring vigilance, yet pardoning, overlooking and forgiving are urged since Allah is Forgiving and Merciful; wealth and children identified as a trial against which Allah holds a great reward; taqwa to the extent of ability joined to listening, obeying and spending as better for themselves, with success promised to whoever is guarded from his soul's stinginess; the goodly loan to Allah multiplied and forgiven by the Most Appreciative and Forbearing; the surah closing with the Knower of unseen and witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Beware of them — some wives and children are enemies.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدِكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا لَّكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُمۡۚ وَإِن تَعۡفُواْ وَتَصۡفَحُواْ وَتَغۡفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: But if you pardon and overlook and forgive — then indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَٱسۡمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنفِقُواْ خَيۡرٗا لِّأَنفُسِكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend.

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the resurrection oath and its ease (7) before the belief-Quran-Day of Assembly block opens (8); P2 ends with tawheed and reliance (13) before the domestic-enemy warning begins (14); P3 covers wives-children enmity, wealth-children trial, capacity-taqwa, the goodly loan and the closing name-pair (14-18).
